texts.gestures: Middle-drag: radius · Shift+middle-drag: strength · Ctrl: the opposite (Length shortens, Lift lays down, Shape shrinks; painting, toward 0) · Shift+drag: paint the selection (the rest frozen) · Shift+click: add the guides in the ring (on none: deselect and unfreeze all) · painting maps or Freeze, Shift+drag: smooth · with the GroomLab hotkey set: B / M + drag radius / strength, Page Up / Down the level, Alt+Shift+X symmetry
texts.symmetryTip: Alt+Shift+X turns it on or off (with the GroomLab hotkey set: GroomLab > Help > Install GroomLab Hotkeys). While it is on, a red line on the scalp shows the mirror plane for as long as a brush is on; the brushes that mirror (and Place, Draw, Select) use it.
texts.eraseNote: Erase removes guides (with their children), parts and flow arrows, not the scattered hair. To take hair away, paint the density map holding Ctrl (Paint tab > + New Map > for a setting > Density).
texts.flowArrows: Drag to lay arrows; drag over arrows to comb them; Ctrl erases.
texts.flowSinks: Click to place, the size of the brush; Ctrl-click removes sinks.

app.gestures: B / M + drag (or middle-drag / Shift+middle-drag): radius / strength · Ctrl: the opposite (Length shortens, Lift lays down, Shape shrinks; painting, toward 0) · Shift+drag: paint the selection (the rest frozen) · Shift+click: add the guides in the ring (on none: deselect and unfreeze all) · painting maps or Freeze, Shift+drag: smooth · Page Up / Down: the level · Alt+Shift+X: symmetry · Y + click: the marking menu
